title: Remove Unused MCP Tools

prompts.prompt: Remove tools from mcp: analyze, contributor add, contributor delete, export, file create, file delete, file move, folder, graphql, move, policy check, ticket read

steps.name: Identify root cause of incomplete IDs

events.pattern:
python3 << 'PYEOF'
with open('/workspaces/semio/semio-repo/cli/main_test.go', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

count = 0

# Fix entry.Event["kind"].(string) -> string(entry.Event.Kind)
old = 'entry.Event["kind"].(string)'
new = 'string(entry.Event.Kind)'
if old in content:
    n = content.count(old)
    content = content.replace(old, new)
    count += n
    print(f"Fixed {n} entry.Event[kind] refs")

# Fix eventMap["kind"] references  
old = 'eventMap["kind"]'
new = 'string(entry.Event.Kind)'
if old in content:
    n = content.count(old)
    content = content.replace(old, new)
    count += n
    print(f"Fixed {n} eventMap[kind] refs")

# Fix eventMap["client"] references
old = 'eventMap["client"]'
new = 'entry.Event.Client'
if old in content:
    n = content.count(old)
    content = content.replace(old, new)
    count += n
    print(f"Fixed {n} eventMap[client] refs")

# Fix eventMap["session"] references
old = 'eventMap["session"]'
new = 'entry.Event.Session'
if old in content:
    n = content.count(old)
    content = content.replace(old, new)
    count += n
    print(f"Fixed {n} eventMap[session] refs")

# Fix eventMap["timestamp"] references
old = 'eventMap["timestamp"]'
new = 'entry.Event.Timestamp'
if old in content:
    n = content.count(old)
    content = content.replace(old, new)
    count += n
    print(f"Fixed {n} eventMap[timestamp] refs")

# Fix eventMap["transcript"] references
old = 'eventMap["transcript"]'
new = 'entry.Event.Transcript'
if old in content:
    n = content.count(old)
    content = content.replace(old, new)
    count += n
    print(f"Fixed {n} eventMap[transcript] refs")

# Remove unused eventMap declarations
# Find and remove "var eventMap map[string]interface{}" lines that are now unused
import re
# Remove standalone "var eventMap map[string]interface{}" lines
content = re.sub(r'\n\s*var eventMap map\[string\]interface\{\}\n', '\n', content)
print("Removed unused eventMap declarations")

print(f"Total fixes: {count}")
with open('/workspaces/semio/semio-repo/cli/main_test.go', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)
PYEOF
